headline: Morning routine: cleanse, 2-3 drops, tap and spread
footnote: AI illustrations of a routine, not results. 4.1 out of 5 stars from 2,013 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Headline across the top; three equal portrait frames left to right (Step 1 · Cleanse & tone / Step 2 · 2-3 drops / Step 3 · Tap & spread), each with a dark label bar along its bottom edge, showing AI-generated illustrations of the same person doing each routine step (frames_prompt); AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; small real pack shot bottom-right; routine-not-results note and rating in the footnote band; CTA "Shop now" bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a matte off-white tiled wall above a narrow stone shelf, soft morning window light from the upper left. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the whole central band of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit and calm, reserved for three image panels and copy placed later, and keep the lower right corner empty for a pack photo. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: routine journey (timeline). Frame labels come straight from the page's usage: after cleansing and toning, take 2-3 drops on the fingertips, tap on gently and spread in a circular motion (F14), AM & PM (F15, in the headline). Kept: headline naming the steps in order (Foxtale), 'Step N' labels beside a person (Dot & Key), numbered frames in a row with one action each (Pilgrim). Dropped: 'Glow' and 'Treat' step names, concern-led headline, the happy-model result feel, and the page's brightening, dark-spot, collagen, 'heal' and photo-ageing wording and study stats. No before/after, no time-to-result labels, no visible skin change. Frames are AI-generated (High risk, labelled). Rating in the footnote.

blend_sources.took: headline that names the routine steps in order
'Step N' labels sitting beside a person
numbered cards in a row, one action each

frames_prompt: The same Indian woman in her late 20s with deep-brown skin, her morning routine at her home bathroom basin, in all three panels wearing the same plain cotton top with her hair tied up in a soft cloth band, framed the same way from the shoulders up beside the basin, with the same off-white tiled wall and the same soft morning window light from the upper left. Panel 1: she rinses her face with both cupped hands over the basin, eyes closed, then pats it dry with a plain towel. Panel 2: her fingertips are held together just below her chin, as if about to press a few drops onto her cheek, nothing visible on her fingertips. Panel 3: her fingertips tap gently along her cheek and then her palms move in a slow circular motion. Actions only: her skin looks identical in all three panels, with natural texture and true-to-life deep-brown colour, and the three panels read as one continuous routine. No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.
